messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: INC-4823 -> inference-queue-DEADLOCK detected in eu-west-1. Multiple requests stalled, autoscaler not increasing. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
ben (oncall): Acked. I'm on it, jumping into logs now :eyes:
carla: I saw spikes in queue latency, might be KV cache eviction thrash. Any customer impact yet?
ben (oncall): Customer error rate rising for /v1/stream, some requests timing out at 30s. CS reports 2 paying customers affected. Tagging @customer-success for comms.
customer-success-bot: Noted. Preparing a short customer-facing status that we can send in ~10m.
alex (sre): Ben, can you try scaling the pool manually? run: `redwoodctl pool scale --region eu-west-1 --pool inference-1 --replicas +2` Could buy us time.
ben (oncall): Running manual scale now...
ben (oncall): Output:
```
$ redwoodctl pool scale --region eu-west-1 --pool inference-1 --replicas +2
Scaling request accepted. New desired replicas: 12
```
ben (oncall): New replicas spinning up, but I'm still seeing stuck workers holding KV locks, they don't accept connections.
maria (eng): If workers are stuck on KV eviction, try forcing a graceful restart of the unhealthy pods: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer-worker -n inference-eu` — but be cautious, that will drop in-flight requests.
carla: Are we able to identify a common model or request shape that triggered the stall?
ben (oncall): Quick grep of recent logs shows a hot prefix from a customer using long-context chat generation. Pattern: repeated re-requests of the same prefix, causing huge KV growth. snippet:
```
[2026-02-15T23:01:12Z] rpc: Append request for session=psi-92 prefix_len=10240
[2026-02-15T23:01:12Z] kvcache: growth to 1.2GB per shard
[2026-02-15T23:01:12Z] worker: eviction stall, waiting on lock
```
alex (sre): That explains it — autoscaler sees latency but workers are stuck in eviction loops. I'm in favor of restarting the stuck pods one-by-one to avoid full service drop.
ben (oncall): Will do rolling restart starting with the worst CPU pods. Status ping in 2m.
carla: Meanwhile, can we add a temporary routing rule to send new requests to dedicated pool in us-east-1? Avoids impacting eu customers while we heal.
maria (eng): We have capacity in us-east-1. I can add a quick smart-route override: `routing.set --from eu-west-1 --to us-east-1 --match \"model:chat-xl AND latency>2s\" --ttl 15m` — pushing now.
ben (oncall): Rolling restart in progress: pod infer-worker-7 -> restarted. Watching metrics.
alex (sre): CPU on restarted pod came back ok, KV cache trimmed. Latency dropping.
ben (oncall): Restarted 3 pods so far. Error rate down from 7% -> 1.5% over last 5m. Customer-facing note ready: short apology + mitigation + ETA 15m. @customer-success-bot please review.
customer-success-bot: Draft: \"We're experiencing degraded performance for inference in eu-west-1 due to internal cache eviction issues. We've rerouted traffic and are rolling worker restarts to restore service. Next update in 15m.\" :thumbsup:
carla: Good. Keep monitoring for regressions, and create a temp alert to catch kv cache growth >800MB/shard.
ben (oncall): Adding alert rule now. `monitoring create-rule --name \"kvcache-growth-eu\" --expr \"kvcache_bytes_per_shard > 800MB\" --notify #incidents`
ben (oncall): Rule created. Also escalating to oncall-sre for awareness.
alex (sre): Acknowledge. I'll stay on the bridge until stabilization completed.
ben (oncall): Status 23:41Z — latency back to baseline for most routes, two customers still seeing intermittent slow responses. Continuing to monitor. Owner: ben (oncall). Handoff planned if page persists after 00:15Z.
maria (eng): I'll follow up with a short mitigation PR to limit max prefix length for new sessions and add kvcache metrics to alerting.
carla: Please capture runbook steps — what we did and why, so postmortem is faster.
ben (oncall): On-call notes saved to incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incident/INC-4823 (draft). Will populate steps and timeline.
alex (sre): If we stay stable for 30m, we can close the page and do a full postmortem tomorrow with data and knobs to prevent recurrence.
ben (oncall): Last ping 23:49Z — service stable, error rate ~0.3%, closing PD page in 5m unless anything pops.
carla: :thumbsup: great work. Recommend follow-up actions: model usage quota, soft-limits on prefix bytes, and longer-term KV eviction optimization.
ben (oncall): Closing note: PD page resolved at 23:54Z. Owner for postmortem: maria (eng). Follow-up doc link added. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
